# Trades

One folder per trade, so trades built in parallel never edit the same lines. Each holds `trade.json` (its name and kit)
and the trade's own docs: customer questions (`questions.md`), what to build (`playbook.md`), its demos and what they
take (`demo-map.md`), its speed numbers (`speed.md`) and the fonts it claims (`fonts.md`). The shared views
(`docs/SPEED-LOG.md`, `docs/CLAIMED-FONTS.md`, `docs/DEMO-MAP.md`, this index) are generated from those files by
`npm run docs`, and `npm run rules` fails if one is stale. A trade's code lives in its kit, `src/kits/<kit>/`.
